title: Marilyn Spellforge
description: A stylized digital painting of a blonde woman in a blue and red superhero-style outfit with a flowing red scarf, posed dynamically while holding a lit sparkler. Behind her is a large mirror reflecting her image, with red curtains, a table holding a laptop, red gloves, and tools, plus various handwritten labels like 'Marilyn', 'Spellforge', 'Pin-up Forge', and 'Prototype' visible throughout the scene.
prompt: A glamorous blonde woman with an elaborate updo and red hair accessory, wearing a tight blue bodysuit with red belt and scarf, posed confidently while holding a lit sparkler in one hand. She stands in a workshop with red curtains, a large mirror reflecting her back view, a table with a laptop, red gloves and tools.
